sourceFormFieldsExtended.govdataSubjectsUnavailable: The server has not listed the AskAmerica subjects yet. Try again in a moment.
sourceFormFieldsExtended.validatingApiKey: Validating API key and pre-loading metadata… this may take up to 30 seconds on first use.
sourceFormFieldsExtended.pathGlobHint: Glob pattern relative to transport root. Supports csv, parquet, arrow, json, xlsx, docx, pptx, md, html, .gz, .zip.
sourceFormFieldsExtended.loadProtectedTooltip: Never query this source live — always serve the last materialized snapshot, and refresh it only inside the off-peak window. Protects a fragile or rate-limited source from query load. A per-table setting can override this default.
sourceFormFieldsExtended.changeSignalTooltip: Default change-detection signal inherited by this source's tables (each table can override it). Options are gated by the source type's capabilities.
sourceFormFieldsExtended.cdcTransportDescription: Entered once per source. Tables from this source only choose delivery=cdc; they inherit this transport.
sourceFormFieldsExtended.loadManagementHelp: How current the data must be for each reader, balanced against load on the platform and upstream sources.
sourceFormFieldsExtended.loadManagementInfo: Balances how current each reader's data is against load on the platform and on upstream sources. Ideally the upstream manages its own load; the operator protects the platform, and the upstream when it can't protect itself. These settings are the operator's floor — no query or request hint can get fresher data or put more load on a source than they allow. Readers can only choose to accept older data for speed. A table the engine reads live ignores the TTL settings; they apply once it is served from its replica (Replicate, or Load Protected).
sourceFormFieldsExtended.sentinelPathTooltip: URL of a marker file the producer touches when its data changes (file:, ftp:, sftp:, http:, https:). With a probe change signal, Provisa checks only this marker to decide whether the data is fresh. Leave empty for no sentinel.
sourceFormFieldsExtended.sentinelPathInvalid: Use a file:, ftp:, sftp:, http: or https: URL, or leave empty.
sourceFormFieldsExtended.freshnessGateTooltip: Check freshness (from the change signal and Cache TTL) before each read of this source's tables, and refresh first when stale. Needs a Cache TTL for ttl signals; push signals can't gate.
sourceFormFieldsExtended.maxLiveConcurrencyHelp: Upper bound on queries reading this source live at once, across every Provisa instance sharing this Redis. Queries beyond it wait up to their own deadline, then fail. Empty = no cap. Has no effect when the source is read from its replica (Replicate / load protected).
sourceFormFieldsExtended.maxLiveConcurrencyInvalid: Enter a whole number of 1 or more, or leave empty for no cap.
sourceFormFieldsExtended.loadManagementFixErrors: Fix the Load Management and Timeliness settings before saving.
sourceFormFieldsExtended.cacheTtlRequiredForSignal: The {{signal}} change signal judges staleness by the Cache TTL, so set a Cache TTL.
sourceFormFieldsExtended.accessTokenHint: Stored in the secrets vault. A ${secret:NAME} or ${env:NAME} reference is also accepted.
sourceFormFieldsExtended.brandNamespaceHint: Prefix of this source's table names. Leave blank for the default.
sourceFormFieldsExtended.sfLoginUrlHelp: Your org's My Domain URL (Setup, then My Domain)
sourceFormFieldsExtended.sfLoginUrlInvalid: Enter the full My Domain URL, starting with https://
sourceFormFieldsExtended.sfSecurityTokenHelp: Only when your org requires one
sourceFormFieldsExtended.coNameACloud: Fill in at least one of Azure, AWS or GCP.
sourceFormFieldsExtended.coRequiredWithCloud: Required once this cloud is named
sourceFormFieldsExtended.coCacheTtlMinutesHelp: How long a result is reused before the clouds are asked again
sourceFormFieldsExtended.wpPagesHelp: One per line: a page title, or the address of a page in the chosen language edition
sourceFormFieldsExtended.wpLanguageHelp: The edition's code, for example en, de or ja. Default: en
sourceFormFieldsExtended.wpMaxDepthHelp: How many links away from a starting page to read. 0 reads only the starting pages. Default: 1
sourceFormFieldsExtended.wpMaxPagesHelp: The most pages one crawl reads. Default: 25
sourceFormFieldsExtended.wpContactHelp: Sent with each request so Wikipedia can reach the operator, as its policy asks
sourceFormFieldsExtended.wpFollowSeeAlsoHelp: Links in a page's "See also" section are looser than links in its text. Off: that section is left out
sourceFormFieldsExtended.wpSeeAlsoHeading: What this edition calls its "See also" section
sourceFormFieldsExtended.wpSeeAlsoHeadingHelp: The section's title as it appears on a page, for example "Voir aussi" on French Wikipedia. Links in that section are left out
sourceFormFieldsExtended.wpSeeAlsoHeadingRequired: Type the section's title, or choose to follow those links above
sourceFormFieldsExtended.wpDirectoryHelp: Where the pages' tables and data files are written. It must be a directory the engine's file connector can write. Empty: a directory of this source's own under Provisa's data directory
sourceFormFieldsExtended.wpCrawlSettings: Crawl settings (each empty field uses the default shown)

wpCrawl.content_selector: Part of the page to read
wpCrawl.remove_selectors: Parts of the page to leave out

wpCrawlHelp.request_delay: A number and a unit, for example 2 seconds
wpCrawlHelp.html_cache_ttl: A source reads its pages again after this long, for example 1 days
wpCrawlHelp.html_table_min_rows: A table with fewer rows is not offered
wpCrawlHelp.html_table_max_rows: A table with more rows is not offered. Empty: no limit
wpCrawlHelp.table_selector: A CSS selector a table must match
wpCrawlHelp.content_selector: A CSS selector: links and tables are read only inside it
wpCrawlHelp.link_selector: A CSS selector a link must match to be followed
wpCrawlHelp.remove_selectors: CSS selectors, one per line. Replaces the whole default list
wpCrawlHelp.link_exclude_patterns: Regular expressions, one per line. A link whose address one of them finds is not followed
wpCrawlHelp.allowed_file_extensions: One per line. A linked file of one of these types becomes a table
wpCrawlHelp.max_html_size: For example 10MB. A larger page is not read
wpCrawlHelp.max_data_file_size: For example 100MB. A larger file is not read
